title: Hezbollah Rebuffs Lebanese Government Overtures to Withdraw from Strategic Ali al-Taher Ridge
detail: August 29, 2026 — President Joseph Aoun, working with Hezbollah-allied Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri, pressed Hezbollah to hand over the strategic Ali al-Taher ridge in south Lebanon to the Lebanese Army, but the group refused to withdraw, the Times of Israel reported, citing Israeli sources. Aoun had contacted the ridge's dispute over the past several days (per Naharnet's Aug. 26 report) seeking to head off an Israeli strike on the position, warning that 'Israel occupying the hill and carrying out massive explosions in it' would have repercussions for surrounding villages. Unnamed sources warned Hezbollah's intransigence could prompt Israel to escalate and widen its campaign against the group, while Israel signaled it would not make further withdrawal concessions in south Lebanon until Hezbollah disarms. The standoff further delayed scheduling of the next US-brokered Rome verification round, expected in early September.
